211:     const contactSentiment = this.ctx.readText(contactData.sentiment).trim() || 'NEUTRAL';
212:     const leadScore = this.ctx.readText(contactData.leadScore, '0');

217:     const currentInput = {

222:     let cognitiveState: Record<string, unknown> = {
